gen-gf-shantell-sans-fs-public-sans: Shantell Sans draws neon-tube letters with one glowing line thickness and a wide, open mouth. Public Sans follows with a hefty, low lowercase and broad counters, so long paragraphs feel sturdy and trustworthy.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-fs-ranade: Shantell Sans has a mouth wide as a cut tin lid, with stems and arches of identical thickness. Ranade lets its curves thicken gently at the shoulders and spreads its stroke ends apart, so the two feel loosely related but clearly distinct.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-fs-supreme: Expressive and a bit wild up top, Shantell Sans keeps a level beat with no accents of weight, while Supreme runs a heavy-looking, low strip of text below. Crisp plain sans meets hand-drawn play.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-general-sans: General Sans fills the line with a tall x-height and a smooth path around each bend. And Shantell Sans, with its wide-mouthed display letters, adds the playful, distinctive voice on top.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-orbit: Shantell Sans arrives wide-mouthed and expressive, drawn with one fixed nib. Orbit is what you want once the fun is done: its curves stop short and each character floats apart, rope-steady in every stem and tail.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-science-gothic: Shantell Sans opens wide, like the cut lid of a tin can, and keeps one fixed nib width throughout. And Science Gothic, approachable with stroke ends set far apart, reads one letter at a time with no thick and thin parts.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-syncopate: Loose, wide-mouthed and handmade in feel. Syncopate steps in below with open c, e and s shapes and spacing like rungs on a rope ladder, a technical-pen steadiness against the heading's playful nib.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-manrope: Wide-mouthed, expressive, and quick to grin. Manrope keeps a bright open gap at each curve and a minimal cap-to-lowercase step, so longer text moves along in a friendly, easy way.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-montserrat: Expressive is the first word for Shantell Sans, with its wide mouths and single fixed nib width. And Montserrat gives it room to breathe, with oversized e and a counters and a line that glides like wire.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-satoshi: Shantell Sans has a mouth wide as a cut tin lid, drawn at a single nib width. It does the expressive work at moderate height, while Satoshi's soaring x-height and wide-open e handle the plain sans reading.
